items.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks by integrating language models with external tools and environments. However, their autonomy poses significant safety risks: agents may execute destructive commands, leak sensitive data, or violate domain constraints. Existing safety approaches face a fundamental tradeoff: hand-crafted rules are interpretable but brittle, with overly conservative rules blocking safe operations (high false positives) while permissive rules miss unsafe behaviors (high false negatives). Neural classifiers lack the interpretability required for safety-critical deployments. We present AutoSpec, a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP). Starting from the expert rules and a stream of annotated traces, AutoSpec iteratively evaluates rules, mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, uses ILP to learn which predicates discriminate them, generates candidate rule edits, and verifies candidates to select the best revision. The key insight is that ILP efficiently identifies predicates that appear frequently in false negatives but rarely in false positives (or vice versa), dramatically pruning the exponential search space of rule edits. This continues until convergence, producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall. We evaluate AutoSpec on 291 execution traces spanning code execution and embodied agent domains. AutoSpec raises rule F1 to 0.98 and 0.93 across the two domains, achieving up to 94% false positive reduction while maintaining high recall, and converges within 4-5 iterations. The ILP-guided approach achieves up to 4.8x higher F1 than heuristic CEGIS. The learned rules are human-readable, auditable, and generalize to unseen scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 AutoSpec，一个基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的框架，用于自动演化大语言模型（LLM）智能体的安全规则。LLM 智能体通过集成外部工具和环境实现复杂任务自动化，但其自主性带来严重安全风险，如执行破坏性命令、泄露敏感数据或违反领域约束。现有方法存在根本性权衡：手工规则可解释但脆弱，过于保守的规则会阻塞安全操作（高误报），而宽松的规则会遗漏不安全行为（高漏报）；神经分类器则缺乏安全关键部署所需的可解释性。AutoSpec 利用反例引导的归纳合成（CEGIS），从专家设计的规则和用户标注的安全/不安全轨迹流出发，迭代地评估规则、挖掘误报和漏报反例，通过 ILP 学习区分它们的谓词，生成候选规则编辑并验证以选择最佳修订。关键见解是 ILP 能高效识别在漏报中频繁出现但在误报中罕见（或相反）的谓词，从而大幅剪枝规则编辑的指数级搜索空间。该过程持续至收敛，产生平衡精确率和召回率的可解释规则。在涵盖代码执行和具身智能体两个领域的 291 条执行轨迹上评估，AutoSpec 将规则的 F1 分数分别提升至 0.98 和 0.93，实现高达 94% 的误报减少同时维持高召回率，并在 4-5 次迭代内收敛。ILP 引导的方法相比启发式 CEGIS 实现了高达 4.8 倍的 F1 提升。学习到的规则人类可读、可审计，并能泛化到未见场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 智能体的安全规则自动化演化是实际部署中的关键痛点，AutoSpec 首次将 ILP 应用于此问题，显著优于手工规则和启发式方法，且保持可解释性，对安全工程师开发可靠智能体系统有重要参考价值。

items.title: Detect, Unlearn, Restore: Defending Text Summarization Models Against Data Poisoning
items.summary: Training-time data poisoning during fine-tuning poses a significant threat to large language models (LLMs) deployed for abstractive text summarization, where small task-specific datasets exert disproportionate influence on model behavior. In this setting, adversaries manipulate fine-tuning data to induce persistent summarization failures, such as biased or harmful summaries, while preserving standard evaluation metrics. We present a unified post-hoc defense framework for detecting and remediating fine-tuning-stage poisoning in summarization models across the machine learning supply chain. Our experiments show that in white-box settings, poisoned document-summary pairs exhibit abnormally high training influence, enabling detection via influence-function analysis with semantic consistency checks. In black-box settings, poisoned models display two to three times greater sensitivity to semantics-preserving perturbations, enabling behavioral auditing without training data access. Beyond existing poisoning formulations, we introduce novel attacks targeting factual distortion and representational bias, showing that poisoning alters summarization behavior without triggering conventional alarms. Across nine architectures and six benchmark datasets under adaptive attacks, our defenses achieve 85-92% detection precision, while gradient-ascent unlearning restores up to 96% of original behavior with minimal utility loss (less than 0.6% ROUGE degradation). These results indicate that fine-tuning-time poisoning leaves persistent structural artifacts, enabling practical detection and post-deployment recovery without full retraining.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在抽象文本摘要微调阶段面临的数据投毒攻击，提出了一套统一的防御框架。研究动机在于，微调时使用的任务特定数据集规模较小，攻击者可以通过操纵微调数据植入后门，导致模型生成有偏或有害的摘要，同时保持标准评估指标（如ROUGE）正常。现有防御多针对分类模型，对生成式摘要模型的适用性有限。作者首先提出了两种新型攻击：事实扭曲攻击（使摘要包含错误事实）和表征偏置攻击（使摘要偏向特定群体或观点），证明了传统检测方法难以发现这些攻击。然后，设计了一套后验防御方案，包含检测和恢复两个阶段。在白盒场景（可访问训练数据）下，利用影响函数分析结合语义一致性检查，识别异常高影响力的文档-摘要对，检测精度达85-92%。在黑盒场景（仅可查询模型）下，通过语义保持扰动（如同义替换）检测模型敏感性异常，发现被投毒模型的扰动敏感性是正常模型的2-3倍，从而实现行为审计。恢复阶段采用梯度上升遗忘技术，仅移除投毒样本的影响，模型原始行为恢复率高达96%，且ROUGE指标下降不足0.6%，无需完整重训练。实验覆盖9种架构（包括BART、T5、Pegasus等）和6个基准数据集（如CNN/DailyMail、XSum等），并针对自适应攻击（攻击者知晓防御策略）进行了评估。结果表明，微调阶段的投毒会在模型参数中留下持久的结构性痕迹，从而为实际部署后的检测与修复提供了可能。本文适合LLM安全研究者、模型供应链安全工程师以及关注数据投毒防御的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次聚焦文本摘要模型的微调数据投毒防御，提出可落地的检测与恢复方案，填补了生成式NLP安全领域的重要空白，对保护LLM供应链安全具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 防御方法可迁移到其他序列生成任务（如机器翻译、对话生成），并启发后续针对LLM微调投毒的检测与遗忘研究。

items.title: Tracing Target Answers in Poisoned Retrieval Corpora via Token Influence Attribution
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to corpus poisoning attacks that manipulate model outputs through malicious retrieved documents. Existing detection methods typically rely on auxiliary classifiers or additional LLM-based verification, introducing substantial computational overhead. We present TRACE, a lightweight detection framework that identifies poisoning attacks by tracing answer-related tokens through token influence attribution. TRACE first discovers recurrent high-influence keywords across retrieved documents and then performs a secondary verification to confirm their influence on model predictions. Experiments on three QA benchmarks and six LLMs demonstrate strong detection performance while simultaneously uncovering attacker-specified target answers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过从外部语料库中检索相关文档来增强大语言模型的输出，但这种机制也引入了安全风险：攻击者可以通过向语料库中注入恶意文档来操控模型输出，即语料投毒攻击。现有检测方法通常依赖辅助分类器或额外的LLM验证，计算开销大，且可能被绕过。本文提出TRACE（Token influence attribution for answer tracing in poisoned corpora），一种轻量级检测框架，通过token影响力归因来识别投毒攻击。TRACE首先在多个检索文档中发现反复出现的高影响力关键词（这些关键词通常是攻击者植入的触发器），然后对这些关键词进行二次验证，确认它们是否对模型预测具有显著影响。实验在三个问答基准（Natural Questions、TriviaQA、WebQuestions）和六个LLM（LLaMA、Mistral、GPT等）上进行，结果表明TRACE能够高效检测投毒攻击，同时揭示攻击者指定的目标答案。该方法无需训练额外的分类器，仅依赖模型梯度或嵌入计算，具有低开销和可迁移性。研究团队将在GitHub上开源代码。本文主要面向安全研究人员和RAG系统开发者，提供了一种实用的防御思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG系统被广泛部署，但语料投毒攻击威胁大且难检测。TRACE提供了一种轻量级、无需额外模型训练的检测方案，可直接集成到现有RAG流程中，对防御实践有直接价值。

items.title: How Reliable Is Your Jailbreak Judge? Calibration and Adversarial Robustness of Automated ASR Scoring
items.summary: Almost every paper on LLM jailbreaks and prompt injection reports an attack-success rate (ASR), and that number is assigned not by people but by an automated judge: either a safety classifier trained for the task, or a general chat model prompted to grade. The judge is rarely checked. We check it. Using 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set, we compare the two judge families against human majority votes and then attack them. The two families fail in opposite ways. The dedicated classifier over-flags (precision 0.835, recall 0.974); three different LLM-as-judges keep high precision (0.81 to 0.94) but show erratic recall (0.06 to 0.65), so the same responses produce very different ASR depending on which judge scores them. The two families also differ sharply in robustness. Wrappers that leave the harmful text untouched and only add benign framing flip every LLM-judge between 57% and 100% of the time, and a single prepended refusal sentence accounts for much of this (39% to 88%). The dedicated classifier resists these surface attacks (at most 6.7%), but a white-box GCG attack on its open weights flips 70% of confident true positives (21 of 30; 95% CI 54 to 86%) even at a small optimization budget. A two-annotator audit confirms the attacks leave the harm intact: every one of 80 sampled flips still contained the harmful content. Because a large and growing share of reported ASR comes from LLM-judges, many such numbers are unreliable both on average and under deliberate pressure. We recommend that papers report judge precision and recall on a human-labeled slice, report ASR corrected for judge precision, and include an adversarial check of the judge. Our code is released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了大型语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击中自动攻击成功率（ASR）评分的可靠性。当前几乎所有越狱论文都依赖自动化评判器（专用安全分类器或通用聊天模型）来报告ASR，但这些评判器本身的准确性很少被检验。作者利用HarmBench分类器验证集中596个人工标注的补全结果，将两类评判器与人类多数投票结果进行比较，并对其发动对抗攻击。研究发现两类评判器以相反的方式失败：专用分类器过度标注（精确率0.835，召回率0.974）；而三种LLM作为评判器虽保持高精确率（0.81-0.94），但召回率波动极大（0.06-0.65），导致同一响应因评判器不同而得到完全不同的ASR。两类评判器在鲁棒性上也存在显著差异：仅添加良性框架而不改变有害文本的包装器可使LLM评判器在57%-100%的情况下翻转判定，其中单个前置拒绝语句即可造成39%-88%的翻转；专用分类器能抵抗这些表面攻击（翻转率≤6.7%），但针对其开放权重的白盒GCG攻击可在小优化预算下使70%的可靠真阳性翻转（21/30，95%置信区间54%-86%）。两注释者审核确认攻击未改变危害性：80个翻转样本中每一个仍包含有害内容。由于报告ASR中来自LLM评判器的比例越来越大且仍在增长，许多ASR数值在平均情况下和刻意压力下均不可靠。论文建议：报告评判器在人工标注切片上的精确率和召回率；报告经评判器精确率校正后的ASR；包含对评判器的对抗性检查。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭露了当前LLM安全评估中的关键漏洞——ASR评分可能因评判器选择而严重失真，导致越狱攻击效果被高估或低估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有依赖自动评分报告的LLM安全研究，可能导致对模型安全性的错误判断。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: What Does It Mean to Break a Distillation Defense?
items.summary: Black-box LLMs (accessible only via API) are vulnerable to distillation attacks, in which an attacker queries the model and trains a student on its outputs. A recent line of work proposes output perturbation defenses that modify the teacher's output to reduce student performance while preserving utility for legitimate users. As a relatively new family of approaches, output perturbation defenses lack a shared threat model, making it difficult to compare them, reason about composing them with other attacks, or evaluate their robustness against realistic adversaries. This underspecification matters beyond technical evaluation: when defenses are deployed to protect intellectual property or justify regulatory compliance, an imprecise threat model can create a false sense of security. We propose a threat model framework that describes attackers along three dimensions: a query budget, a data budget, and an interface profile that captures how attackers interact with the API. Using antidistillation sampling as a case study, we show that whether the defense is considered effective depends on the assumed threat model. We argue that future work on distillation defenses, along with any governance or policy frameworks built around them, should explicitly specify and stress-test attacker capabilities along our three dimensions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文聚焦于黑盒大语言模型（LLM）的蒸馏攻击防御问题。蒸馏攻击是指攻击者通过查询目标模型（教师模型）的API，利用其输出训练一个学生模型，从而窃取模型能力。近期，研究者提出了一系列输出扰动防御方法——通过修改教师模型的输出，在降低学生模型性能的同时，尽可能不影响合法用户的正常使用。然而，这类防御方法缺乏统一的威胁模型，导致难以进行公平比较、评估与其他攻击组合时的鲁棒性，也无法验证其面对真实攻击者的有效性。这种威胁模型的不规范不仅影响技术评估，更可能在实际部署（如保护知识产权或合规监管）时造成虚假的安全感。为此，作者提出一个威胁模型框架，从三个维度刻画攻击者：查询预算（API调用次数）、数据预算（可用于蒸馏的样本量）和接口轮廓（攻击者与API的交互方式，如是否可获取logprobs、是否可选择采样温度等）。以反蒸馏采样（antidistillation sampling）这一具体防御方法为案例，作者展示了同一种防御在不同威胁模型假设下有效性截然不同，从而论证了明确攻击者能力的重要性。论文的核心贡献是：为蒸馏防御领域提供了第一个系统化的威胁模型框架，并呼吁未来关于蒸馏防御的研究及其衍生出的治理与政策框架，都应明确指定并压力测试这三个攻击者维度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 蒸馏防御是保护黑盒LLM知识产权的关键技术，但缺乏统一威胁模型导致评估结果不可比、防御可能被轻易绕过。本文提出的框架为安全从业者提供了系统评估防御鲁棒性的方法论，有助于避免虚假安全感。

items.title: ShareLock: A Stealthy Multi-Tool Threshold Poisoning Attack Against MCP
items.summary: With the rapid evolution of LLM-driven agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open protocol bridging LLMs with external tools, has quickly become foundational to modern agent ecosystems. However, the expanding adoption of MCP has also introduced novel security concerns such as Tool Poisoning Attack (TPA), which exploit LLM-server interactions to inject malicious prompts. Existing poisoning schemes typically adopt a monolithic plaintext embedding paradigm, which fails to withstand manual inspection or automated detectors. Current research still lacks a systematic analysis on multi-tool poisoning, where multiple tools can be exploited cooperatively to disperse detection risk. In this paper, we introduce ShareLock, a multi-tool threshold poisoning framework that utilizes Shamir's threshold scheme to ensure exceptional stealth and fault tolerance. ShareLock distributes the malicious instruction as benign-looking secret shares across multiple tool descriptions, achieving both information-theoretic secrecy and attack robustness against moderate auditing. After a covert reconstruction trigger is planted during server update, the aggregated shares reconstruct the hidden instruction, resulting in critical breaches of system assets or private data. To evaluate the realistic threat of ShareLock, we constructed a comprehensive benchmark encompassing four multi-tool scenarios and conducted extensive experiments across mainstream LLMs on two distinct MCP clients. Our results demonstrate that ShareLock significantly outperforms existing single-tool poisoning strategies in tool description-based detection while maintaining an average attack success rate exceeding 90%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体生态系统中新兴的安全威胁，提出了一种名为ShareLock的隐蔽多工具阈值投毒攻击框架。研究背景是：随着Model Context Protocol（MCP）协议成为连接LLM与外部工具的核心标准，工具投毒攻击（TPA）通过注入恶意提示利用LLM-服务器交互，但现有单一工具投毒方式易于被人工审查或自动化检测器发现，且缺乏对多工具协同投毒的系统分析。ShareLock创新性地应用Shamir阈值秘密共享方案，将恶意指令拆分为多个看似无害的“秘密份额”，分发到与正常功能无关的工具描述中。这些份额单独无法还原恶意指令，从而实现了信息论安全性和对中等程度审计的鲁棒性。攻击者在服务器更新时植入一个隐蔽的触发条件，当MCP客户端在特定上下文中触发该条件时，各份额会自动聚合重建完整恶意指令，导致系统敏感资产泄露或数据被窃取。为评估威胁，作者构建了包含四个多工具场景的综合基准测试（如代码执行、文件读取、数据库查询、Web搜索），并在两个主流MCP客户端上对多个LLM进行实验。结果显示，ShareLock在基于工具描述的检测中显著优于现有单工具投毒策略，同时平均攻击成功率超过90%。该研究揭示了MCP生态中一类新型、更隐蔽的攻击路径，对LLM智能体安全防御提出了新挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体依赖MCP调用外部工具，ShareLock通过多工具协同投毒绕过了现有检测机制，威胁真实且隐蔽，安全从业者需关注此类新型攻击面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响使用MCP协议的LLM智能体系统，攻击者可远程窃取敏感数据或控制系统工具，风险面涵盖开发、测试及生产环境。

items.title: Jailbreaking for the Average Jane: Choosing Optimal Jailbreaks via Bandit Algorithms for Automatically Enhanced Queries
items.summary: With a profusion of jailbreaks for LLMs now widely known, a growing concern is that non-expert malicious actors ("the average Jane") could elicit actionable responses to malicious requests. In this work, we examine whether this concern is justified. A non-expert malicious actor requires two ingredients for a successful attack: a powerful jailbreak for their target model, acting on an effective malicious query. For the former, we propose a novel attack strategy based on the multi-armed bandit framework. This allows efficient online learning of the optimal jailbreak from a large choice set via noisy exploration on a small number of queries, with subsequent application of the learnt policy on an exploitation set. For the latter, we curate $\mathrm{FrankensteinBench}$, a safety benchmark of $11,279$ malicious queries drawn from manual curation over $7$ existing benchmarks, along with automated enhancement and generation. Each query is categorized as simple or complex by the technical expertise required to craft it. Our findings confirm the concern. Our bandit-based attack achieves success rates as high as $97\%$ on average over $15$ SoTA open-weight LLMs. Moreover, adding complexity to queries raises the attack success rate by up to $26\%$ on average across models -- making it an effective, automatable prompting strategy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一个关键安全问题：非专业恶意攻击者（“普通用户”）能否利用现有的大量越狱方法来高效攻击大型语言模型（LLM）。作者提出了一个基于多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandit）框架的新型攻击策略，该策略能够通过少量恶意查询的噪声探索，从众多越狱方法中在线学习并选择最优解，然后应用于大规模恶意查询集。为了支持实验，作者构建了FrankensteinBench基准测试，包含11,279个基于7个现有基准手动整理并自动增强的恶意查询，并按所需技术难度分为简单和复杂两类。实验在15个开源权重LLM上进行，平均攻击成功率高达97%。此外，增加查询的复杂性（如通过自动化提示工程）可使平均攻击成功率提升26%，表明该策略高效且可自动化。本文从攻击者视角揭示了LLM面临的严峻威胁，强调即使是非专业攻击者也可能利用自动化工具实现高成功率攻击。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示非专业攻击者利用自动化工具即可高效越狱LLM，打破“需专业知识”的假设，促使防御者重新评估威胁模型并加强防御。

items.title: A Deterministic Control Plane for LLM Coding Agents
items.summary: LLM coding harnesses grant agents broad file and shell access, yet the configuration layer that steers them -- rules files, agent definitions, IDE-specific markdown -- is largely unmanaged. A prevalence study of 10,008 public GitHub repositories (n=6,145 agent config files) finds that agent configurations propagate as undeclared shared components: 10.1% of tracked paths are SHA-256 exact duplicates across independent repositories (fork-adjusted, threshold-independent), with 75.5% of clone pairs crossing organisational boundaries. Two further patterns are indicative: configurations are rarely revised (58% single-commit; 0.4 vs 0.6 commits/month age-normalised against CI/CD workflows), and rarely declare permission boundaries (<1% of agent configs vs 33% of Actions workflows, n=31 true positives). We propose a deterministic control plane above the harness that maps one-to-one to these gaps. Rel(AI)Build treats agent definitions as a managed supply chain (SHA-256 content addressing, HMAC-stamped lockfiles, hash-chained audit logs); enforces tiered permissions and attack-derived blocklists before LLM invocation; gates feature work through a phase state machine with requirement-to-file-to-test traceability; compiles a single canonical definition to seven IDE targets; and detects prompt drift via Jaccard similarity. Conformance tests on injected violations confirm each mechanism enforces its stated invariant; developer outcomes remain future work. Governance of this layer must be deterministic and tool-agnostic -- not delegated to further LLM orchestration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对LLM编码代理（如Cline、Codex等）的配置层管理缺失问题展开研究。作者对10,008个公共GitHub仓库中的6,145个代理配置文件进行了大规模流行度分析，发现三个关键问题：1) 配置作为未声明的共享组件传播，10.1%的跟踪路径在不同独立仓库中为SHA-256精确重复，且75.5%的克隆对跨越组织边界；2) 配置极少修订，58%的配置文件仅有一个提交，与CI/CD工作流相比标准化提交频率低（0.4 vs 0.6次/月）；3) 权限边界声明严重不足，仅不到1%的代理配置文件声明权限，而GitHub Actions工作流中有33%。基于这些发现，论文提出了一个确定性的控制平面——Rel(AI)Build，它位于现有LLM编排层之上，与工具无关。该方案将代理定义视为托管供应链，采用SHA-256内容寻址、HMAC戳记锁文件和哈希链审计日志；在LLM调用前实施分层权限检查和基于攻击模式的阻止列表；通过包含需求-文件-测试可追溯性的阶段状态机来门控功能开发；将单一规范定义编译至七个IDE目标格式；并利用Jaccard相似度检测提示漂移。合规测试验证了每个机制能正确执行其所述的不变量。论文主张，代理配置的治理必须是确定性的、可审计的，不应委托给进一步的LLM编排。尽管开发者体验评估尚为未来工作，但该研究为LLM代理的安全应用提供了系统化治理框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM编码代理在开发中广泛使用，但其配置缺乏管理导致权限滥用、供应链安全风险。本论文揭示了问题的普遍性并提出了可落地的确定性控制方案，对保障LLM代理安全至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用LLM编码代理的组织，可迁移至CI/CD供应链安全、LLM应用治理、以及任何需要细粒度权限控制的代理场景。

items.title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
items.summary: Agent safety in high-stakes domains requires formal policy enforcement, but most existing approaches either rely on probabilistic guardrails (fine-tuned classifiers, prompt-based steering) that offer no formal guarantees, or on hand-coded symbolic enforcement that does not scale to the breadth of real policy specifications. We present an autoformalization pipeline that translates agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions, and natural language policy documents into formally verified policies using an LLM-based generator-critic loop. The resulting policies are written in the Cedar Policy Language. On the MedAgentBench benchmark, our autoformalized policies cover substantially more of the source natural-language specification than the hand-coded symbolic enforcement in prior work.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种自动化形式化（autoformalization）流水线，用于将智能体提示（agent prompts）、MCP工具描述和自然语言策略文档转化为形式化验证的策略。现有方法要么依赖概率性护栏（如微调分类器、提示引导），缺乏形式化保证；要么依赖手工编码的符号化执行，无法扩展到现实策略规范的广度。本文的方法基于LLM的生成-评论循环（generator-critic loop），生成的策略采用Cedar策略语言编写。在MedAgentBench基准测试中，自动形式化的策略覆盖了比先前工作中手工编码符号化执行更广泛的源自然语言规范。该工作旨在提升高风险领域中智能体安全的形式化策略执行能力，使策略合规性可被自动验证，并减少人工编码错误。适合对AI Agent安全、形式化验证和策略工程感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次将自然语言策略自动转化为形式化验证的策略，弥合了非正式规定与正式执行之间的鸿沟，为AI Agent在高风险领域的安全合规提供了可扩展、有保证的解决方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于医疗、金融、自动驾驶等需严格策略合规的AI Agent部署场景，提升策略覆盖率和验证自动化水平。

items.title: VIGIL: Runtime Enforcement of Behavioral Specifications in AI Agent Skills
items.summary: Agentic systems increasingly act through third-party skills, allowing model-generated decisions to affect files, communication channels, and cyber-physical devices. These skills often include natural-language specifications that define access permissions, disclosure limits, execution privileges, and required preconditions. Although such specifications describe the intended boundaries of skill behavior, they do not by themselves provide executable runtime enforcement. Enforcing them raises a contextual granularity challenge: even when a policy is written for a particular task context, a monitor must still decide which events to observe, what state to retain, how far across the execution to reason, and where to intervene. Choosing the wrong granularity can either block benign executions or miss violations that emerge only across multiple actions. Most existing enforcement mechanisms, however, assume a fixed event model or enforcement point. In this work, we present VIGIL, an end-to-end runtime enforcement framework for agentic systems. VIGIL checks an agent's actual execution trace against behavioral policies from skill specifications, operator-defined constraints, and global rules spanning multiple skills. To make such policies executable, VIGIL introduces a policy language that captures context-specific enforcement requirements over agent-tool events, including temporal dependencies, argument constraints, and value-flow conditions. The language is paired with symbolic evaluation rules that translate policies into SMT constraints over finite traces, allowing VIGIL to detect violations that depend on event order, argument relationships, or cross-call value flow rather than relying on fixed single-call filters. On real LLM-agent runs spanning office-document, operational, and engineering tasks, VIGIL detects policy violations with over 95% recall and a false-positive rate below 10%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 VIGIL，一个面向智能体系统的端到端运行时行为规范执行框架。随着智能体系统越来越多地通过第三方技能（skills）执行模型生成的决策，这些技能通常包含自然语言编写的规范，定义访问权限、披露限制、执行权限和前置条件。然而，这些规范本身不具备可执行的运行时保障。VIGIL 解决了上下文粒度挑战：即使策略是为特定任务上下文编写的，监控器仍需决定观察哪些事件、保留什么状态、推理多远以及何时干预。错误的粒度可能导致阻塞良性执行或错过跨多个动作才出现的违规。现有执行机制大多假设固定的事件模型或执行点。VIGIL 检查智能体实际执行轨迹，对比来自技能规范、操作员定义约束和跨多个技能的全局规则的行为策略。为使策略可执行，VIGIL 引入了一种策略语言，能够捕获对智能体-工具事件的上下文特定执行要求，包括时间依赖、参数约束和值流条件。该语言结合符号评估规则，将策略转换为有限轨迹上的 SMT 约束，从而检测依赖于事件顺序、参数关系或跨调用值流的违规，而非依赖固定的单次调用过滤器。在真实的 LLM 智能体运行（涵盖办公文档、操作和工程任务）上，VIGIL 的政策违规检测召回率超过 95%，误报率低于 10%。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 AI 智能体被授权操作文件、通信和物理设备，确保其行为符合安全规范至关重要。VIGIL 提供了首个面向第三方技能的运行时强制机制，能有效检测跨动作的违规，大幅降低误报。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有依赖 LLM 智能体的自动化系统，尤其是涉及文件操作、网络通信和物理设备控制的场景，可增强策略执行的可信度。

items.title: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
items.summary: Recent work (2024 to 2026) has converged on a strategy for defending tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection: rather than training the model to refuse malicious instructions, enforce security outside the model with a deterministic policy that mediates the agent's actions. Systems such as CaMeL, FIDES, Progent, RTBAS, and FORGE realize this with capabilities, information-flow labels, and reference monitors, and several report near-elimination of attacks on the AgentDojo benchmark. We make two contributions. First, we organize these out-of-band defenses as instances of classical integrity protection (Biba), reference monitoring, and least privilege, yielding a structured comparison of what they do and do not cover. Second, we warn that every one of them is validated only on static benchmarks (a fixed set of injection attempts), the same methodology that made in-band defenses look strong until adaptive, defense-aware attacks broke twelve of them at over 90% success; we specify the threat model and protocol an adaptive evaluation requires. We then run that protocol as an independent reproduction and extension of Progent's own adaptive-attack analysis, on AgentDojo, with an open-weight agent (Qwen2.5-7B) self-hosted on a single H200, a setting its authors did not test. Averaged over three runs, the defense held: Progent cut mean attack success roughly sixfold (25.8% to 4.2%), and a hand-crafted adaptive attack did not raise it (2.6%). This is one small-scale data point on a weak model with a single black-box attack template; a stronger optimized (white-box GCG) attack remains open. The result is consistent with, but does not establish, the hypothesis that deterministic out-of-band enforcement is a harder target for an adaptive attacker than in-band detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于LLM智能体在工具调用场景下对间接提示注入攻击的防御问题。近期（2024-2026年）的研究趋同于一种带外防御策略：不是训练模型拒绝恶意指令，而是在模型外部通过确定性策略中介智能体的行动，例如CaMeL、FIDES、Progent、RTBAS和FORGE等系统，它们利用能力、信息流标签和引用监视器实现防御，并在AgentDojo基准上报告近乎完全消除攻击。本文做出两项贡献：首先，将这些带外防御组织为经典完整性保护（Biba模型）、引用监视器和最小权限原则的实例，从而结构化对比它们的覆盖范围与遗漏之处；其次，指出所有这些防御目前仅在静态基准（固定注入尝试集）上验证，而正是同样的方法论曾使带内防御看起来很强，直到自适应、防御感知攻击以超过90%的成功率攻破了其中十二种。因此，作者明确了自适应评估所需的威胁模型和协议，并独立复现和扩展了Progent的自适应攻击分析，在AgentDojo上使用开源权重模型Qwen2.5-7B（自托管于单张H200 GPU上）进行实验。三次运行的平均结果显示，Progent将平均攻击成功率从25.8%降至4.2%，而手动设计的自适应攻击并未提高成功率（2.6%）。作者指出这只是一个基于弱模型和单一黑盒攻击模板的小规模数据点，更强优化的白盒GCG攻击仍有待研究。结论与“确定性带外强制比带内检测更难被自适应攻击者攻破”的假设一致，但尚未确立。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究指出了当前LLM智能体提示注入防御评估中的方法论缺陷（仅依赖静态基准），并提供了首个独立的自适应评估结果，为防御有效性验证提供了更严格的标准。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响LLM智能体安全防御技术的评估方法论，可能推动安全社区采用自适应攻击测试来验证防御体系。

items.title: Nanoelectromechanical Systems (NEMS) for Hardware Security in Advanced Packaging
items.summary: As hardware security threats escalate across semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging, there is a growing need for novel physical mechanisms to counter sophisticated attacks such as tampering, counterfeiting, and supply chain infiltration. This paper presents Nanoelectromechanical Systems (NEMS) as an emerging class of hardware security primitives that enable physical assurance, tamper detection, and authentication at the device level. Leveraging mechanisms such as NEMS-based Physically Unclonable Functions (PUFs), shape memory materials, resonance-based fingerprints, and physical unlocking architectures, these systems offer enhanced resilience to reverse engineering, side-channel attacks, and environmental degradation. By harnessing mechanical unpredictability and fabrication-induced nanoscale variability, NEMS technologies introduce a physically robust and low-power alternative to conventional digital security methods. Their seamless integration into standard semiconductor workflows paves the way for scalable, verifiable, and secure solutions across defense, aerospace, critical infrastructure, and consumer electronics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出将纳米机电系统（NEMS）作为先进封装中硬件安全的新型物理原语。随着半导体制造和封装过程中的安全威胁日益严峻（如篡改、伪造、供应链渗透），传统的数字安全方法面临被逆向工程、侧信道攻击等挑战。NEMS通过利用纳米尺度的机械可变性、形状记忆材料、谐振指纹以及物理解锁架构，实现了设备级的物理保证、篡改检测和认证。具体地，基于NEMS的物理不可克隆函数（PUF）利用制造过程中引入的纳米级随机变化产生唯一且不可预测的响应，显著增强了对逆向工程和克隆攻击的抵抗力。形状记忆材料可在特定条件下改变状态，用于防篡改封装。谐振指纹通过检测器件独特的机械振动模式进行身份验证。这些机制共同提供了低功耗、物理鲁棒的解决方案，可无缝集成到标准半导体工艺中。实验表明，NEMS方案在抗环境退化、抗侧信道攻击方面优于传统数字方法。该工作为国防、航空航天、关键基础设施和消费电子等领域提供了可扩展、可验证的安全解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件安全威胁日益严峻，传统数字安全方法面临物理攻击风险。NEMS提供一种全新的物理层安全原语，利用纳米机械特性实现不可克隆性和防篡改，有望弥补现有半导体安全体系的薄弱环节。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于先进封装中的防伪、供应链完整性验证、设备认证等场景，特别适合对物理安全要求极高的国防、航空航天、关键基础设施领域。

items.title: Verifying Intent and Harm: A Unified Defense Against LLM-Generated Threats
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in interactive applications, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial interactions that induce harmful, deceptive, or policy-violating outputs. Existing defenses typically analyze either user prompts or generated outputs, but not both. However, many real-world attacks exploit a separation between adversarial intent expressed in the prompt and actionable harm manifested only in the response. As a result, prompt-only and response-only defenses frequently miss unsafe interactions that appear benign when viewed from either side in isolation. We present a verification-centric defense framework that jointly evaluates prompt intent and response harm before an LLM response is delivered to a user. The framework employs specialized analysts for intent and harm assessment together with a Judge for conflict resolution. We formalize a threat model for prompt-response attacks and evaluate the framework across five threat categories: jailbreaks, prompt injection, phishing, cyber abuse, and harmful content. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that jointly verifying prompt intent and response harm consistently outperforms single-sided defenses and single-agent reasoning baselines. Across threat categories, the framework improves average F1 from 0.90 for the strongest applicable baselines to 0.95 while reducing the average attack success rate to 4.1 percent. Compared with a Single-Agent+CoT baseline, it improves average F1 from 0.87 to 0.95 and reduces the false positive rate on benign-sensitive requests from 0.12 to 0.06. We further evaluate architecture-aware adaptive attacks in which the attacker knows the verifier structure and attempts to bypass individual verification components. Our results suggest that prompt-response verification provides a practical foundation for securing LLM applications against evolving adversarial threats.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在交互式应用中部署日益广泛，但仍易受到对抗性交互的影响，导致产生有害、欺骗性或违反政策的输出。现有防御通常仅分析用户提示（prompt）或生成输出（response），但许多实际攻击利用了提示中的对抗意图与响应中可操作危害之间的分离，导致单侧防御常常遗漏看似无害的交互。为此，本文提出一种以验证为中心的防御框架，在LLM响应交付给用户之前，联合评估提示意图和响应危害。该框架采用专门的分析器分别评估意图和危害，并设立一个裁决器（Judge）进行冲突解决。作者形式化了提示-响应攻击的威胁模型，并在五种威胁类别（越狱、提示注入、钓鱼、网络滥用和有害内容）上评估了框架。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，联合验证提示意图和响应危害始终优于单侧防御和单智能体推理基线。在所有威胁类别上，该框架将平均F1分数从最强基线的0.90提升至0.95，同时将平均攻击成功率降至4.1%。与单智能体+思维链基线相比，平均F1从0.87提升至0.95，对良性敏感请求的误报率从0.12降至0.06。此外，作者还评估了架构感知的自适应攻击，其中攻击者知晓验证器结构并试图绕过单个验证组件。结果表明，提示-响应验证为保护LLM应用免受不断演变的对抗性威胁提供了实用基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作首次系统性地联合验证提示意图与响应危害，显著优于现有单侧防御方法，为LLM应用安全提供了可落地的防御框架。

items.title: Beyond Takedown: Measuring Malicious Go Module Persistence in the Wild
items.summary: We measure an automation-based supply chain campaign in the Go ecosystem. The attackers repackage legitimate Go modules under attacker-controlled owners, and embed them with obfuscated code for an import-triggered downloader. Our results come from two complementary analyses: a) a manual search on GitHub across 2,113 repositories and b) a large-scale scan of 12.3M index entries using a deobfuscating AST scanner (GOAST) that we implemented. As a result, we identified 2,289 malicious versions of legitimate Go modules. We demonstrate that purely GitHub-centric searches fail to identify the full extent of the compromise and are only effective for as long as the affected code is present on the platform. Moreover, our proxy-based measurements of the takedown-remediation gap reveal that among artifacts later found to be GitHub-unobservable (i.e., removed or suspended), at least 99.4% remained retrievable via Go proxy. Following our disclosure, GitHub has removed 684 malicious repositories and the Google Go team has remediated 1,377 module versions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文测量了Go生态系统中的一种自动化供应链攻击。攻击者将合法的Go模块重新打包到其控制下的所有者账户中，并嵌入混淆代码作为导入触发的下载器。研究者通过两种互补分析方法进行测量：一是对GitHub上2,113个仓库进行手动搜索；二是使用自实现的去混淆AST扫描器（GOAST）对12,300万个索引条目进行大规模扫描。结果识别出2,289个合法Go模块的恶意版本。研究表明，仅以GitHub为中心的搜索无法完全识别攻击范围，且仅在受影响代码仍然存在于平台上时才有效。此外，通过代理基线的测量发现，在后续被判定为GitHub不可观察（即已移除或暂停）的工件中，至少99.4%仍然可以通过Go代理检索到。在研究者披露后，GitHub移除了684个恶意仓库，Google Go团队修复了1,377个模块版本。该工作揭示了当前供应链安全措施（如下架）的局限性，即恶意模块的持久性远超平台可见范围。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了下架机制在供应链安全中的盲区：即使从GitHub删除，恶意Go模块仍可通过官方代理持续传播，极大延长了攻击窗口，对依赖管理提出新挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Go生态系统所有使用Go proxy的模块使用者；攻击者可利用持久性长期维持恶意模块的可达性，绕过传统下架响应。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 评估内部Go模块依赖策略，考虑定期清理代理缓存并监控异常模块版本。

items.title: RAS: Measuring LLM Safety Through Refusal Alignment
items.summary: Safety evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is commonly performed by querying models with unsafe or jailbreak prompts and judging whether their outputs violate a safety policy. Although useful, output-level evaluation is expensive, sensitive to judge choice, and easily tied to fixed question banks. We propose **SafeVec**, a white-box evaluation procedure that measures safety from internal representations rather than generated answers. **SafeVec** first extracts layer-wise refusal directions from a safety-aligned reference model, then selects stable layer windows where safe and unsafe behaviors are separable, and finally scores a target model by measuring whether its hidden states align with these refusal directions under unsafe and jailbreak prompts. The resulting metric, **RAS** (**R**efusal **A**lignment **S**core), maps representation-level refusal alignment to a calibrated 0-100 safety score. Across `Llama`, `Gemma`, and `Qwen` model families, RAS separates aligned models from uncensored and abliterated variants, tracks output-level attack success rate, and is substantially faster than judge-based evaluation. These results suggest that refusal alignment provides a compact and efficient signal for white-box LLM safety evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 SafeVec 的白盒评估方法，用于衡量大型语言模型（LLM）的安全性。传统的安全性评估通常依赖于向模型输入不安全或越狱提示，并判断输出是否违反安全策略，这种方法成本高、对评判选择敏感且容易受限于固定题库。SafeVec 则从模型内部表示而非生成答案入手：首先从安全对齐的参考模型中提取逐层拒绝方向（refusal directions），然后选择能够区分安全与不安全行为的稳定层窗口，最后通过测量目标模型在处理不安全或越狱提示时隐藏状态与这些拒绝方向的对齐程度，计算出一个校准的 0-100 安全分数，称为 RAS（Refusal Alignment Score）。在 Llama、Gemma 和 Qwen 等模型家族上的实验表明，RAS 能够有效区分安全对齐模型与未审查或去对齐的变体，能够跟踪输出级别的攻击成功率，并且比基于评判的评估方法快得多。论文认为拒绝对齐提供了一个紧凑且高效的白盒 LLM 安全评估信号。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种基于内部表示的白盒安全评估方法，速度快且不依赖输出评判，有助于自动化检测 LLM 的安全对齐程度。

items.title: CrypFormBench: Benchmarking Formal Analysis Capability of Large Language Models for Cryptographic Schemes
items.summary: Manual formal analysis of cryptographic schemes is labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise. While model-checking tools (e.g., Scyther and Tamarin) and computational-security tools (e.g., CryptoVerif and EasyCrypt) improve the automation of security proofs, they still rely on experts to abstract schemes and write tool-specific formal descriptions. Large language models (LLMs) are a promising alternative, but their effectiveness in this domain remains unexplored due to the absence of standardized evaluation methodologies. To fill this gap, we introduce CrypFormBench (C.F.B for short), a comprehensive benchmark jointly covering symbolic and computational security to evaluate five core LLM capabilities: interpretation, generation, completion, transformation, and correction. It comprises 700 instances spanning 677 schemes, 7 mainstream formal verifier languages, and 160 security properties. The evaluation of 9 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that most of them perform well on interpretation and completion, given their code-awareness advantages, but struggle with generation, transformation, and correction. Overall, their performance remains limited, with Claude-3.5 achieving the highest score at 48.7 out of 100. We further provide practical guidance, e.g., few-shot prompting, Pass@K sampling, and lightweight fine-tuning, to mitigate the executability bottleneck and improve tool-usable outputs. Taken together, our benchmark and analyses offer a grounded view of current progress and concrete directions toward reliable LLM-assisted formal cryptographic analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了 CrypFormBench (CFB)，一个用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在密码方案形式化分析方面能力的综合基准。手动进行密码方案的形式化分析需要大量专业知识和时间。虽然模型检测工具（如 Scyther、Tamarin）和计算安全性工具（如 CryptoVerif、EasyCrypt）提高了安全证明的自动化程度，但专家仍需抽象方案并编写特定工具的形式化描述。LLM 被视为一种有前途的替代方案，但由于缺乏标准化评估方法，其在此领域的有效性尚未得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，CrypFormBench 同时涵盖符号安全和计算安全，评估 LLM 的五项核心能力：解释、生成、补全、转换和校正。该基准包含 700 个实例，涵盖 677 个方案、7 种主流形式化验证语言和 160 个安全属性。对 9 个最先进的 LLM 的评估显示，大多数模型在解释和补全任务上表现良好（得益于其代码理解优势），但在生成、转换和校正任务上表现不佳。总体而言，它们的性能仍然有限，Claude-3.5 得分最高（48.7/100）。论文进一步提供了实用指导，例如少样本提示、Pass@K 采样和轻量级微调，以缓解可执行性瓶颈并提高工具可用输出。该基准和分析为当前进展提供了实证观点，并为实现可靠的 LLM 辅助形式化密码分析指明了具体方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统评估 LLM 在密码方案形式化分析中的能力，填补了标准化基准的空白，对推动 AI 辅助安全证明自动化有重要意义。

items.title: Representation Matters: An Empirical Study of Program Representations for LLM Vulnerability Reasoning
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated vulnerability detection, but it remains unclear how program structure and semantics should be represented for LLM-based reasoning. Most prompting-based approaches provide raw source code, implicitly assuming that more source-level context gives the model better evidence. This paper challenges that assumption through RepBench, an empirical benchmark comparing raw source code with static-analysis-based program representations. RepBench converts real-world C/C++ vulnerability testcases into multiple representations: raw source, Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), Control-Flow Graphs (CFGs), Program Dependence Graphs (PDGs), their combinations, and an auxiliary track of enriched PDGs (ePDGs). Using a curated PrimeVul-derived corpus of 107 Joern-based testcases across five CWE categories, we evaluate ten representation variants under a fixed Chain-of-Thought and structured-output protocol, plus 19 additional ePDG cases generated through VulChecker/Hector. Representation choice substantially affects LLM vulnerability reasoning. The strongest variant, AST+PDG, achieves 83.2% accuracy, compared with 53.5% for raw source. At the family level, graph-only prompts outperform both source-only and source-plus-graph prompts while requiring far less prompt overhead. These results reveal a context dilution effect: adding raw source code to compact structural graph evidence can degrade reasoning by making vulnerability-relevant evidence less salient. Overall, our findings show that carefully selected structural representations offer a better accuracy-overhead tradeoff than simply giving LLMs more raw input, and suggest that static analysis can serve as an effective prompt-construction layer for security-focused LLM reasoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文通过实证研究探讨了在大语言模型（LLM）进行漏洞推理时，程序结构和语义表示方式的影响。作者提出了RepBench基准，将真实世界的C/C++漏洞测试用例转换为多种表示：原始源码、抽象语法树（AST）、控制流图（CFG）、程序依赖图（PDG）及其组合，以及增强PDG（ePDG）。实验使用基于PrimeVul整理的107个Joern测试用例，涵盖5个CWE类别，在固定思维链和结构化输出协议下评估了10种表示变体，并额外使用VulChecker/Hector生成的19个ePDG案例。结果表明，表示选择显著影响LLM的漏洞推理性能。最强的表示AST+PDG达到了83.2%的准确率，而原始源码仅为53.5%。图级提示在家族层面优于仅源码或源码加图的提示，且提示开销更低。研究揭示了上下文稀释效应：在紧凑的结构图证据中加入原始源码可能会降低推理性能，因为漏洞相关证据不再突出。总体而言，精心选择的结构化表示比简单地给LLM更多原始输入提供了更好的精度-开销权衡，表明静态分析可以作为面向安全LLM推理的有效提示构建层。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM漏洞检测中表示工程的关键性，证明结构化表示（如AST+PDG）能显著提升准确率，为安全分析师利用LLM进行自动化漏洞分析提供了实用指导。

items.title: HelpBench: Assessing the Ability of LLMs to Provide Privacy, Safety, and Security Advice
items.summary: This paper introduces HelpBench, a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs are capable of providing accurate help in response to questions about digital privacy, safety, and security. We curated 450 questions representing authentic user situations and developed rubrics for each question to evaluate the factual accuracy and tone of a response. Example questions touch on how to regain access to lost or suspended accounts, how to balance the trade-offs of hardware security keys versus other forms of two-factor authentication, whether a suspicious email is likely a scam, or whether an abuser might be able to track an individual based on their device peripherals. We then developed and applied an auto-rater to evaluate responses from 18 state-of-the-art LLMs. Our results indicate that while models provide high-quality advice (with scores of 82% on average), one in ten responses from models scores less than 65%, reflecting inaccurate and even harmful advice. Addressing these failures is critical for models to serve as trustworthy sources of assistance for digital privacy, safety, and security needs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 HelpBench，一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在数字隐私、安全和安全方面提供准确帮助能力的基准测试。研究团队收集了 450 个代表真实用户情景的问题，内容涵盖如何重新访问丢失或暂停的账户、如何平衡硬件安全密钥与其他双因素认证形式的权衡、可疑电子邮件是否为诈骗、以及施虐者能否通过设备外围设备追踪个人等。针对每个问题，他们开发了评估响应事实准确性和语气的评分标准。随后，他们构建并应用了一个自动评分器，对 18 个最先进的 LLM 的响应进行评估。结果显示，虽然模型平均提供了高质量的建议（平均得分 82%），但每十个响应中就有一个得分低于 65%，反映出不准确甚至有害的建议。研究强调，要使得 LLM 成为数字隐私、安全和安全需求方面值得信赖的帮助来源，必须解决这些失败案例。该论文适合 LLM 开发者、安全研究人员和对 AI 安全应用感兴趣的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 正被越来越多地用于提供安全建议，但本研究揭示了模型输出中约 10% 的低质量响应可能误导用户，甚至导致实际安全风险。安全团队需警惕此类 AI 辅助的风险，并在部署前进行严格评估。

items.title: PowerFuzz: Power-Based Black-Box Firmware Fuzzing
items.summary: Fuzzing is widely used for software and hardware verification, offering an effective alternative to random testing. While gray-box fuzzers benefit from full visibility into the system under test and can leverage execution feedback such as branch coverage, these approaches are not applicable when verifying systems whose firmware or binaries are not publicly available. In such scenarios, obtaining coverage information for guiding the fuzzer becomes infeasible. In this paper, we introduce PowerFuzz, a statistical black-box fuzzing framework that leverages power side-channel measurements as a substitute for binary instrumentation, requiring no internal visibility into the target firmware. A central challenge in black-box firmware fuzzing is determining the executed branches during test execution. To address this challenge, we use power traces to identify branches utilizing a sliding window followed by a growing window full-trace correlation method. This approach also enables the construction of a high-level control-flow graph of the black-box firmware, which we utilize to drive the fuzzer to unexplored execution paths. Extensive evaluation using three embedded hardware platforms and ten firmware benchmarks demonstrates that PowerFuzz can provide branch coverage comparable (within 13.5%) to gray-box fuzzers while significantly outperforming (up to 22%) state-of-the-art black-box fuzzers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PowerFuzz，一种基于功耗侧通道测量的黑盒固件模糊测试框架。其核心挑战在于黑盒环境下无法获取覆盖率信息来指导模糊器。PowerFuzz 利用目标设备在执行不同代码路径时产生的功耗差异，通过滑动窗口和增长窗口全轨迹相关方法从功耗迹线中识别出执行的分支，进而构建固件的高层控制流图。该控制流图用于引导模糊器探索未执行的路径，从而提升代码覆盖率。在三个嵌入式硬件平台和十个固件基准测试上的评估表明，PowerFuzz 的代码分支覆盖率可与灰盒模糊器媲美（差距在 13.5% 以内），并且显著优于现有最先进的黑盒模糊器（提升高达 22%）。该方法适用于无法获取固件二进制或源码的场景，为嵌入式设备安全测试提供了新途径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为黑盒固件模糊测试提供了创新方案，无需固件源码或二进制文件即可实现接近灰盒的覆盖率，对物联网和嵌入式设备的安全检测有重要实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何无法进行二进制插桩或获取固件的嵌入式/物联网设备安全测试场景，尤其适用于第三方固件或遗留系统。

items.title: Inside Crypter-as-a-Service: An Ecosystem Analysis of the exploit.in Underground Forum Research Talks
items.summary: Crypter-as-a-Service (CraaS) has become a key enabling layer of the contemporary malware economy by providing on-demand evasion capabilities through underground service markets. In this paper, we present a longitudinal characterization of the CraaS ecosystem on exploit.in, a major Russian-language cybercrime forum with a presence on both the clear web and the dark web. From a collection of approximately 1,000,000 posts, we combine keyword filtering, LLM-assisted annotation, and manual validation to extract a corpus of 491 threads and 2,949 posts spanning January 2020 to August 2025. Our analysis shows that crypters on exploit.in are not merely sold as static tools, but as continuously maintained operational services whose value depends on recurring stub renewal - sometimes on a daily basis - sustained antivirus evasion, and trust-based delivery. We develop a taxonomy of five seller types and four buyer profiles, and map the buyer-seller correspondences that structure market transactions. We further document pricing models ranging from low-cost per-build Telegram bot services to high-end custom development and salaried recruitment. Using social-network analysis, we find that the market is hierarchically structured around a small core of highly central actors, many of whom appear to function as trust brokers or other influential intermediaries, while its stability relies on a broader trust and governance infrastructure including escrow, guarantors, reputation systems, and security deposits. Finally, we discuss differences between the CraaS model observed on exploit.in and that reported on HackForums. Although both forums share similar service logics, our corpus suggests that exploit.in exhibits a more professionalized and service-oriented CraaS configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对俄罗斯语网络犯罪论坛exploit.in上的Crypter-as-a-Service（CraaS）生态系统进行了纵向分析。CraaS是恶意软件经济中的关键使能层，通过地下服务市场提供按需的逃避检测能力。研究团队从该论坛收集了约100万条帖子，结合关键词过滤、LLM辅助标注和人工验证，提取出2020年1月至2025年8月间的491个主题和2949条帖子。分析发现，exploit.in上的加密器并非作为静态工具出售，而是作为持续维护的运营服务，其价值依赖于定期（甚至每日）的存根更新、持续的防病毒规避和基于信任的交付。研究者开发了五种卖家类型和四种买家类型的分类法，并映射了市场交易中的买卖双方对应关系。他们记录了从低价按次构建的Telegram机器人服务到高端定制开发和薪资招募的定价模型。通过社交网络分析，发现市场围绕一个高度中心化的小核心层级化组织，其中许多核心角色充当信任经纪人或其他有影响力的中介；市场的稳定性依赖于更广泛的信任和治理基础设施，包括托管、担保人、声誉系统和保证金。最后，讨论并对比了exploit.in与HackForums上的CraaS模式的差异：尽管两个论坛有相似的服务逻辑，但exploit.in表现出更专业化、服务导向的CraaS配置。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了CraaaS这一关键恶意软件使能服务的内部运作，帮助防御者理解攻击者如何获得持续的免杀能力，为检测和破坏地下服务市场提供依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究成果可用于安全团队识别和追踪CraaS提供者，改进恶意软件检测和响应策略，也可用于评估地下论坛信任机制对攻击供应链的影响。

items.title: CORE-BREW: LLR-Based Soft Decoding for Robust Multi-Bit LLM Watermarking
items.summary: Reliable provenance for LLM outputs requires multi-bit watermarks that remain robust under editing while maintaining strict false-positive control. Existing ECC-based LLM watermarks rely largely on hard-decision decoding, discarding token-level reliability information. We propose CORE-BREW, a Constant-hit-Rate Embedding extension of block-wise BREW for robust multi-bit watermarking. CORE-BREW calibrates the watermark channel by targeting a fixed hit rate p-star, yielding closed-form per-token log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) for principled soft-decision decoding. It supports two detection modes: Strict-Safe, which preserves the bounded-distance designated-codeword acceptance region, and FPR-Calibrated, which uses likelihood-based scoring and lightweight list decoding to characterize the FPR-TPR trade-off. Experiments on open-source LLMs under token-level edits and paraphrasing demonstrate improved low-FPR discrimination and robustness over prior multi-bit watermarking baselines while maintaining comparable semantic quality.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）输出溯源的多比特水印问题展开研究。现有基于纠错码（ECC）的水印方法大多采用硬判决解码，未充分利用每个 token 的可靠性信息，导致在编辑攻击（如改写、同义词替换）下鲁棒性不足。作者提出 CORE-BREW（Constant-hit-Rate Embedding extension of block-wise BREW），一种基于对数似然比（LLR）软判决解码的鲁棒多比特水印方案。核心思想是：通过设置固定命中率 p-star 来校准水印通道，从而推导出每个 token 的闭式 LLR 值，实现原则性的软判决解码。CORE-BREW 支持两种检测模式：严格安全模式（Strict-Safe），保持有界距离的指定码字接受区域，确保低误报；以及 FPR 校准模式（FPR-Calibrated），利用基于似然的评分和轻量级列表解码，刻画误报率与真阳率之间的权衡关系。实验在多个开源 LLM 上进行，涵盖 token 级编辑和改写攻击。结果表明，与现有多比特水印基线相比，CORE-BREW 在低误报率下显著提升了区分度和鲁棒性，同时保持了可比的生成语义质量。该方法为 LLM 水印领域提供了新的理论框架和实用工具，尤其适合需要严格假阳性控制且对抗编辑攻击的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 输出溯源是防止模型滥用（如虚假信息、学术作弊）的关键技术。CORE-BREW 提供的软判决解码可显著提升水印在编辑攻击下的鲁棒性，同时保持低误报率，为实际部署更可靠的 LLM 水印系统奠定了基础。

items.title: Taxonomy of Risks on Automated Fact-Checking Systems Considering its Propagation
items.summary: In recent years, the posting of fake news including disinformation and misinformation on social networking services (SNS) has become a social problem. To combat this fake news, fact-checking that is the process of assessing the veracity of posts on SNS has become increasingly important. While fact-checking is currently performed by fact-checking organizations, it is difficult to fact-check all posts on SNS. Therefore, the use of automated fact-checking systems is effective. Recent automated fact-checking systems utilize artificial intelligence and large language models, so there are risks of incorrect judgments and posting incorrect results on social media which can lead to the spread of misinformation or to engage in defamation. In this paper, as a first step toward enabling the safe use of automated fact-checking systems, we categorize the specific risks on automated fact-checking systems. In this categorizing, we consider a three-stage risk propagation: risk factors, hazardous situations, and harm. Our analysis revealed that 32 specific risks exist in automated fact-checking systems. In this paper, we utilize the categorized risks as analytical cues (guide words) to present the risk assessment of the automated fact-checking system DEFAME. This assessment result indicates that risks that cannot be derived using STRIDE, a conventional IT security risk assessment method can be derived using our guide words.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对社交媒体上虚假新闻（包括错误信息和虚假信息）泛滥的问题，提出需要利用自动化事实核查系统来辅助人工核查。然而，当前基于人工智能和大语言模型的自动化事实核查系统存在做出错误判断并发布不准确结果的风险，这可能导致错误信息的进一步传播或引发诽谤。作为确保安全使用这些系统的第一步，论文提出了一种风险分类方法，该分类考虑了三个阶段的风险传播：风险因素、危险情况和危害。通过系统分析，论文识别出自动化事实核查系统中存在的32个具体风险。为了验证分类的有效性，论文将这些分类风险作为引导词（guide words），对现有的自动化事实核查系统DEFAME进行了风险评估。结果显示，与传统的IT安全风险评估方法STRIDE相比，使用论文提出的引导词能够识别出更多无法通过STRIDE导出的风险。该工作为自动化事实核查系统的安全部署提供了结构化的风险分析框架，有助于后续的风险缓解和系统设计改进。

items.title: Application of LLMs to Threat Assessment of Foreign Peacekeeping Missions
items.summary: We present a novel approach for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to threat assessment in the context of foreign peacekeeping missions. Building on the PINPOINT project and its use case, the EU Monitoring Mission in Georgia, we combine an interdisciplinary risk-model with OSINT-based media collection and LLM-supported threat extraction. The proposed workflow maps media contents to mission-relevant threats, extracts structured information and applies several additional LLM-based processing steps to improve relevance and grounding. An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance. These results indicate that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种将大语言模型（LLM）应用于外国维和使命威胁评估的新方法。研究基于PINPOINT项目及其案例——欧盟驻格鲁吉亚监测团，结合跨学科风险模型、开源情报（OSINT）媒体收集和LLM支持的威胁提取。所提出的工作流将媒体内容映射到使命相关威胁，提取结构化信息，并应用多个基于LLM的额外处理步骤以提高相关性和基础性。对从媒体文档中提取的威胁进行的评估显示，自动生成的结果与人类判断在威胁和使命相关性等核心方面具有高度一致性。这些结果表明，LLM为支持维和使命中的分析师提供了一种有前景的方法。该研究主要贡献在于构建了一个半自动化的威胁评估框架，有效减轻了分析师在大量OSINT数据中识别关键威胁的负担，并验证了LLM在该领域的可行性。适合对LLM在安全情报分析中应用感兴趣的研究人员和从业者阅读。

items.title: Chai: Agentic Discovery of Cryptographic Misuse Vulnerabilities
items.summary: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery has proven effective for bug classes like memory safety, where instrumentation confirms memory violations and efficiently filters false positives. Many dangerous vulnerability classes, such as cryptographic misuse, however, lack any comparable instrumentation. In this work, we present Chai, an AI-based system that discovers and validates cryptographic misuse vulnerabilities through naturally occurring signals. To achieve this, Chai rethinks the classical technique of differential testing by leveraging AI to 1) improve precision for detecting real security issues in libraries, and 2) repurpose commonly overlooked discrepancies as leads for tangible vulnerabilities in downstream applications. In doing so, Chai inverts the prevailing paradigm of AI vulnerability discovery: instead of auditing one codebase for many flaws, it catalogs flaws at the library level and propagates them across a cryptographic dependency graph, delivering compounding efficiency gains. We evaluate Chai across X.509, JWT, and SAML libraries. Chai discovered a previously unknown critical vulnerability in an SSL library that powers billions of devices, along with security bugs in one library behind a major web browser and another in major Linux distributions. In total, these techniques surfaced over 100 vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 Chai，一个基于人工智能的漏洞发现系统，专门针对密码学误用漏洞。传统上，AI辅助漏洞发现对内存安全等漏洞类效果较好，因为这些漏洞可以通过插桩验证内存违规并高效过滤误报。然而，许多危险的漏洞类（如密码学误用）缺乏类似的插桩技术。Chai 重新思考了经典的不同测试（differential testing）技术，利用AI提升检测精度，将通常被忽视的差异重新用作下游应用中实际漏洞的线索。具体而言，Chai 颠覆了当前AI漏洞发现的范式：不是审计单个代码库寻找多个缺陷，而是在库级别对缺陷进行编目，并通过密码学依赖图传播，实现复合效率增益。作者在 X.509、JWT 和 SAML 库上评估了 Chai。Chai 发现了一个此前未知的严重漏洞，影响一个驱动数十亿设备的SSL库，此外还发现了一个主流web浏览器使用的一个库以及一个主要Linux发行版中的安全漏洞。总体而言，这些技术发现了超过100个漏洞。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 密码学误用是严重且难以检测的漏洞类别，缺乏有效工具。Chai 首创了基于AI的库级漏洞编目与传播方法，能在大型依赖链中发现批量漏洞，显著提升效率。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面广泛：涉及SSL库、JWT、SAML等关键密码学组件，可延伸到所有使用密码学库的应用程序和系统。

items.title: DKVE: Decentralized Key Validation for End-to-End Encrypted Messaging
items.summary: End-to-end encrypted messaging systems depend on authentic public key distribution to prevent man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks. Current solutions present a stark trade-off: out-of-band (OOB) verification provides strong security but lacks scalability for large contact lists, while key transparency (KT) systems enable automated verification at high storage costs and operational complexity. We propose DKVE, a protocol that validates public keys through privacy-preserving cross-validation within users' social graphs. When obtaining a contact's public key from a key server, clients query mutual contacts to verify they hold the same key, combining Oblivious Pseudorandom Functions (OPRF) and Oblivious Key-Value Stores (OKVS) to preserve privacy of both queries and contact lists. DKVE employs a Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) to aggregate responses and detect server misbehavior with user-configurable error bounds. We evaluate DKVE through simulations on real social network datasets, demonstrating DKVE can detect MitM attacks with exceeding 97% for strong-to-moderate-tie networks. The remaining 3% of cases require validation through alternative methods such as KT and OOB verification. Our proof-of-concept implementation confirms feasibility for background operation on commodity hardware, in terms of the latency and bandwidth. As DKVE can reduce the frequency of KT queries by two orders of magnitude, it enables fundamental architectural shifts: KT directories can migrate from fast but space-inefficient Merkle trees to space-efficient data structures like RSA accumulators. While DKVE cannot replace existing methods entirely -- suffering from bootstrapping problems and degraded performance on weak-tie networks -- it provides a practical complementary key validation mechanism, making secure messaging more deployable for billion-user systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为DKVE的去中心化密钥验证协议，旨在解决端到端加密（E2EE）消息系统中公钥验证的固有难题。当前主流方案存在明显权衡：带外（OOB）验证安全但难以扩展至大规模联系人列表，而密钥透明度（KT）系统虽支持自动化验证，却需要高存储成本和运维复杂性。DKVE利用用户的社交图谱，通过隐私保护的交叉验证来验证公钥。当客户端从密钥服务器获取联系人的公钥时，会向共同联系人（互相联系的好友）发起查询，验证他们所持有的公钥是否一致。该协议结合了不经意伪随机函数（OPRF）和 oblivious 键值存储（OKVS）技术，以保护查询隐私和联系人列表隐私。DKVE 采用序贯概率比检验（SPRT）聚合来自多个共同联系人的响应，以用户可配置的误差界检测服务器的不当行为（例如分发不同的公钥以实施中间人攻击）。通过在真实社交网络数据集上进行模拟，实验表明，在强到中等强度的社交网络（即用户之间有较多共同联系人）中，DKVE 检测中间人攻击的成功率超过97%。剩余的约3%情况需要借助其他方法（如KT或OOB验证）进行额外验证。原型实现表明，在商用硬件上，DKVE 可作为后台进程运行而不显著影响延迟和带宽。值得注意的是，DKVE 能将KT查询频率降低两个数量级，从而支持根本性的架构变革：KT目录可从快速但空间效率低的 Merkle 树迁移至空间效率高的数据结构（如RSA累加器）。尽管DKVE无法完全替代现有方法（存在冷启动问题和弱联系网络性能下降），但它提供了一种实用的互补密钥验证机制，使得安全消息系统在十亿用户规模下更易部署。本文适合密码学研究者、消息系统设计者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种新颖的去中心化密钥验证方法，利用社交图进行隐私保护交叉验证，可大幅降低对密钥透明度系统的依赖，是迈向实用大规模端到端加密消息系统的重要一步。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要大规模公钥验证的端到端加密消息应用，如WhatsApp、Signal等，可减少对中心化或高成本透明度系统的依赖，提升安全性。

items.title: General Techniques for Reducing Key-Switching Overhead in Privacy-Preserving Two-Party Transformer Inference
items.summary: In secure two-party Transformer inference, linear layers are typically evaluated using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) through plaintext-ciphertext or ciphertext-ciphertext matrix multiplications, where key switching primarily occurs and dominates computational overhead in both FHE-based and hybrid FHE-MPC systems. Existing optimizations rely heavily on packing-specific algorithms, limiting their general applicability. Targeting this overhead from a packing-independent perspective, we propose a preprocessing-assisted method for secure attention computation. By decomposing attention into precomputable operations and online interactions, this method reduces online inference-phase key switching without modifying existing packing strategies. However, the first method shifting key switching offline introduces additional storage requirements. To address this, we propose storage-communication trade-off techniques that replace large precomputed ciphertexts with modest online communication, enabling flexible deployment under varying resource constraints. While ciphertext-ciphertext matrix multiplication is offloaded to the preprocessing phase in hybrid schemes and the first layer of FHE-based schemes, these operations still persist in the offline stage and subsequent FHE layers. To further optimize it, we propose a fused key-switch technique targeting the multiplication-followed-by-rotation pattern, which frequently arises in existing RNS-CKKS matrix multiplication schemes. By combining relinearization and rotation into a single procedure, this technique reduces the associated computation costs. Analytical evaluations demonstrate that our proposed techniques significantly reduce online key-switch overhead and provide flexible trade-offs between storage and communication without requiring modifications to existing packing strategies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对安全两方Transformer推理中的密钥切换开销问题展开研究。在隐私保护的两方推理场景中，线性层通常通过全同态加密（FHE）以明文-密文或密文-密文矩阵乘法形式进行评估，其中密钥切换操作是计算开销的主要来源，无论是纯FHE方案还是FHE-MPC混合方案均受此影响。现有优化方法高度依赖特定的数据打包算法，缺乏通用性。为此，作者从与打包策略无关的角度出发，提出了一系列通用技术。首先，设计了一种预处理辅助的安全注意力计算方法：将注意力计算分解为可预计算的操作和在线交互两部分，从而在不修改现有打包策略的前提下减少推理阶段的密钥切换次数。然而，该方法将密钥切换转移至离线阶段，引入了额外的存储需求。为解决此问题，提出了存储-通信权衡技术：用适度的在线通信替代预计算的大尺寸密文，支持在不同资源约束下灵活部署。此外，在混合方案和FHE方案的初始层中，密文-密文矩阵乘法虽被卸载到预处理阶段，但在离线阶段及后续FHE层中仍然存在。为此，针对现有RNS-CKKS矩阵乘法方案中频繁出现的“乘法后接旋转”模式，提出了融合密钥切换技术：将重线性化与旋转合并为单一操作，从而降低相关计算成本。分析评估表明，所提技术显著减少了在线密钥切换开销，并在不改变现有打包策略的前提下提供了存储与通信的灵活权衡。本文适合对隐私计算、同态加密、安全推理及Transformer模型效率优化感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文解决了FHE-based隐私推理中密钥切换这一核心瓶颈，提出的通用技术不依赖特定打包策略，易于集成到现有系统，对推动实用化安全Transformer推理有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何基于FHE的两方或多方安全推理场景，尤其是需要低延迟在线推理的隐私计算服务，为平衡存储、通信与计算开销提供了新思路。

items.title: PRISM: PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix. A 2D Section-Aware Dataset for Static PE Malware Detection
items.summary: We introduce PRISM (PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix), an open dataset and feature representation for static Windows PE malware detection. Existing benchmarks such as EMBER, BODMAS, and SOREL-20M represent each PE file as a flat one-dimensional feature vector, discarding the ordering of sections and the relational context between them. PRISM instead encodes every binary as a two-dimensional matrix whose rows are individual PE sections in file order, with a global summary row that preserves compatibility with EMBER-style models. We build the corpus from four malware sources (BODMAS, MalwareBazaar, VirusShare, and CAPE) together with SOREL-20M benign software, yielding 83,633 deduplicated matrices and a family-filtered analysis corpus of 49,204 samples across 684 malware families. A formal separability analysis (Fisher Discriminant Ratio, mutual information, and inter-section information gain) shows that the per-section positional structure carries discriminative information that flat representations cannot capture. Under a strictly controlled, sample-matched comparison, a gradient-boosted classifier on the compact PRISM representation recovers nearly all of the binary-detection performance of the same classifier on the much larger EMBER vector, at roughly one-sixth the dimensionality; EMBER retains only a small, consistent advantage confined to the extreme low-false-positive regime, the two being operationally indistinguishable at the decision threshold. We are explicit that this binary task is saturated, so the structural content PRISM preserves is reserved for tasks with greater metric headroom, such as family classification and architectures that exploit the 2D structure directly. The dataset, extraction library, trained models, and full analysis pipeline are released under CC BY-NC-SA and MIT licences.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PRISM（PE Relational Inter-Section Matrix），一个面向静态 Windows PE 恶意软件检测的开源数据集与特征表示。现有基准（如 EMBER、BODMAS、SOREL-20M）将每个 PE 文件表示为扁平一维特征向量，丢弃了节的顺序及节间的上下文关系。PRISM 将每个二进制文件编码为二维矩阵：行按文件顺序对应每个 PE 节，并附加一个全局摘要行以保持与 EMBER 风格模型的兼容性。数据集从四个恶意软件源（BODMAS、MalwareBazaar、VirusShare、CAPE）及 SOREL-20M 良性软件构建，共生成 83,633 个去重矩阵，以及一个包含 49,204 个样本（涵盖 684 个恶意家族）的家族过滤分析语料库。通过 Fisher 判别比、互信息和节间信息增益的正式可分离性分析表明，每个节的位置结构携带了扁平表示无法捕捉的判别信息。在严格控制、样本匹配的比较下，基于 PRISM 紧凑表示的梯度提升分类器在二进制检测性能上几乎与基于更大 EMBER 向量的相同分类器相当，而维度仅为后者的约六分之一；EMBER 仅在极低假阳性区域保持微小一致优势，在决策阈值处两者在操作上不可区分。作者明确指出二进制检测任务已饱和，因此 PRISM 保留的结构内容是为具有更大度量空间的进阶任务（如家族分类以及可直接利用 2D 结构的架构）而保留。数据集、提取库、训练模型及完整分析流程以 CC BY-NC-SA 和 MIT 许可证发布。本文适合从事恶意软件检测、特征工程、数据集构建的机器学习研究人员，以及希望探索结构化 PE 表示的安全分析师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: PRISM 提供了一种保留 PE 节顺序和关系的新颖二维特征表示，能揭示扁平向量丢失的判别结构，在家族分类等任务上潜力较大，且数据集开源，便于社区复现与扩展。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能推动 PE 恶意软件检测从传统一维特征向结构化表示演进，并促进针对家族分类、新型架构（如 CNN、Transformer）的研究。

items.title: Type-based information flow analysis for $π$-calculus with a dynamically extensible security lattice
items.summary: We develop a type system for secure information flow where new security levels can be created and inserted into the security lattice dynamically, i.e., even in the middle of an execution of a system. Our system is formalized by extending Kobayashi's type-based secure information flow analysis for Milner's pi-calculus, which is one of the most expressive models (or "languages") supporting both sequential and concurrent computations, with concise syntax, reduction-based semantics, and bisimulation equivalence as a robust formalization of secrecy as non-interference. The development required careful treatment of extensions of lattices themselves as well as deliberate generalization from the simple 2-element lattice (consisting of only High and Low) in the original system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对π-演算的基于类型的安全信息流分析系统，其中安全级别可以在系统执行期间动态创建并插入到安全格中。现有的基于类型的信息流分析方法通常假设安全格是静态的，无法适应运行时安全策略的变化。作者通过扩展Kobayashi等人提出的π-演算的类型化安全信息流分析框架，实现了对动态安全格的支持。π-演算是一种表达能力强的模型，支持顺序和并发计算，具有简洁的语法、基于归约的语义和双模拟等价性，能够稳健地形式化非干扰性的保密性。论文的核心贡献在于：1) 形式化地处理了安全格本身的扩展；2) 将原始系统中简单的二元素格（仅包含高和低两个级别）推广到任意动态可扩展的格结构；3) 通过类型系统确保即使安全格动态变化，程序的信息流仍满足非干扰性。该研究为并发系统中的运行时安全策略自适应提供了理论基础，适合形式化方法、程序语言理论和安全分析领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 动态安全格扩展能力填补了现有类型化信息流分析在处理运行时安全策略变化方面的空白，对自适应安全系统和云环境中的动态安全域管理具有潜在指导意义。

items.title: Fortress and Gatekeeper: Theorizing Transitive Trust in Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Governance
items.summary: Third-party vendors, such as analytics platforms, cloud services, identity providers, and software suppliers, are increasingly embedded in digital service delivery. While these arrangements enable scale and specialization, they also move customer data and security-relevant practices into environments that customers rarely see, select, or evaluate. This paper examines this problem through a document analysis of the November 2025 OpenAI-Mixpanel security incident. The incident serves as an illustrative case for showing how a security event in a vendor environment can become a governance and accountability problem for the focal organization that maintains the customer relationship. Drawing on organizational trust research and agency theory, the paper argues that third-party cybersecurity risk is both a trust relationship and a delegation problem. Customers trust the visible service provider, while the provider relies on vendors whose security practices are only partially visible and controllable. The paper develops the concept of transitive trust, where customer trust in a digital service depends on the security practices of vendors authorized by that service provider. It then presents the Fortress and Gatekeeper framework, which explains cybersecurity governance boundaries through trust and data flows rather than formal organizational ownership alone. The analysis develops four propositions concerning vendor integration, metadata exposure, vendor assurance, and data proliferation. The paper contributes to cybersecurity governance scholarship by explaining how delegated data processing creates customer-facing accountability and by identifying implications for vendor tiering, data classification, contractual design, continuous assurance, and data minimization.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文基于2025年11月OpenAI-Mixpanel安全事件的文档分析，探讨第三方供应商（如分析平台、云服务、身份提供商、软件供应商）嵌入数字服务交付所带来的网络安全治理挑战。核心问题在于：客户数据和安全实践被转移到客户难以查看、选择或评估的环境中，导致责任与信任的错位。论文运用组织信任理论和代理理论，将第三方网络安全风险同时视为一种信任关系和委托代理问题：客户信任可见的服务提供商，而服务提供商依赖其供应商，但供应商的安全实践仅部分可见和可控。论文提出“传递信任”概念，即客户对数字服务的信任取决于该服务提供商授权的供应商的安全实践。进而构建了“堡垒与守门人”框架，通过信任流和数据流（而非仅形式化的组织所有权）来解释网络安全治理边界。基于案例分析，论文提出了四个命题：供应商整合、元数据暴露、供应商保证和数据扩散。主要贡献在于：解释了委托数据处理如何产生面向客户的责任，并识别了对供应商分级、数据分类、合同设计、持续保证和数据最小化等方面的启示。该论文适合安全治理研究者、风险管理人员以及参与供应商评估的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本论文为理解第三方网络安全风险提供了新颖的理论视角，尤其是‘传递信任’概念和‘堡垒与守门人’框架，有助于组织重新审视供应商管理策略，并设计更有效的治理边界与合同条款。

items.title: MIRROR: Novelty-Constrained Memory-Guided MCTS Red-Teaming for Agentic RAG
items.summary: Multimodal agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems expand the attack surface beyond prompt injection to include text poisoning, image injection, direct-query attacks, and orchestrator-level tool manipulation. Existing red-teaming approaches are typically surface-specific and often recycle known attack templates; on text-poisoning benchmarks we measure 73-84% exact duplication. We present MIRROR, a unified cross-surface framework that performs memory-guided Monte Carlo tree search while conditioning candidate generation on retrieved context under an explicit novelty constraint. A deterministic Novelty Gate rejects any candidate matching the retrieval set under normalized comparison, allowing retrieval to inform search priors without enabling prompt copying. Across four attack surfaces on a multimodal agentic RAG target, MIRROR attains 76% ASR on image poisoning compared with 52% for baselines, 97% ASR on orchestrator attacks at half the query cost, and the lowest cross-surface variance (coefficient of variation 0.47). In contrast, specialized baselines collapse across surfaces: suffix optimization reaches 79% ASR on text poisoning but 1% on direct queries. We release ART-SafeBench with 41,815 in-package records and runtime adapters yielding 41,991+ total records across four surfaces.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 MIRROR，一个用于多模态智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统的统一红队框架。当前针对此类系统的攻击面已从简单的提示注入扩展到文本投毒、图像注入、直接查询攻击以及编排器级别的工具操控。现有红队方法通常针对特定攻击面，且常复用已知攻击模板——在文本投毒基准上的测量显示73-84%的完全重复率。MIRROR 通过内存引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），在检索上下文中以显式的新颖性约束条件生成候选攻击。具体地，其新颖性门控（Novelty Gate）在归一化比较后拒绝任何与检索集匹配的候选，从而允许检索信息指导搜索先验，但禁止直接复制提示。在面向多模态智能体 RAG 目标的四个攻击面上，MIRROR 在图像投毒上达到76%的攻击成功率（ASR），基线为52%；在编排器攻击上以一半的查询成本达到97% ASR；跨攻击面变异系数最低（0.47）。相比之下，专用基线在跨攻击面时表现崩溃：后缀优化在文本投毒上达79% ASR，但在直接查询上仅1%。作者同时发布了 ART-SafeBench 数据集，包含41815条包内记录和运行时适配器产生的41991+条总记录，覆盖四个攻击面。本文适合关注 LLM 安全、RAG 系统防御以及自动化红队的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次提出针对多模态智能体RAG系统的统一红队框架，解决了现有方法攻击面单一且攻击模板重复率高的问题，对评估和加固新一代AI系统安全具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至各类结合RAG和工具调用的智能体系统，提升红队测试的自动化程度和覆盖面。

items.title: MergeLLL: A Hierarchical Divide-and-Conquer Framework for LLL-Based Lattice Reduction
items.summary: Lattice basis reduction algorithms have various applications in computational number theory and lattice-based cryptography, but their complexity increases rapidly with the dimension. Motivated by the divide-and-conquer strategy of merge sort and incorporating PotLLL-style deep insertions during recombination, MergeLLL is proposed. In this framework, a lattice basis is split into sub-bases, local reductions are performed independently, and the full basis is reconstructed through hierarchical merging. The approach is focused on improving local lattice structure first before global basis properties are refined, resulting in enhanced Gram-Schmidt orthogonality and numerical stability, while overall computational cost is reduced. The method is naturally parallelizable, allowing efficient multicore and distributed execution. It is shown that the reduction and merging steps preserve the lattice structure through unimodular transformations and achieve logarithmic parallel depth. In experiments on subset-sum and NTRU-derived lattices, improvements over classical lattice reduction algorithms are demonstrated, including better orthogonality, a reduced number of expensive swap operations, and an improved Hermite factor, indicating higher-quality reduced bases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 MergeLLL 的层次化分治格基约化框架，旨在解决经典 LLL 算法在高维格基上计算复杂度急剧上升的问题。受归并排序和 PotLLL 风格深度插入的启发，MergeLLL 将原始格基递归地分割成若干子基，对每个子基独立执行局部约化（如 LLL 或 BKZ），然后通过层次化合并步骤重构完整格基。在合并过程中，采用类似 PotLLL 的深度插入操作进一步优化基向量的 Gram-Schmidt 正交性和数值稳定性。该框架的核心思想是优先改善局部格结构，再逐步优化全局性质，从而在降低整体计算代价的同时提升约化质量。由于各子基的约化可独立进行，MergeLLL 天然支持多核和分布式并行执行，理论上可实现对数级别的并行深度。作者通过数学证明，约化和合并步骤均通过幺模变换保持格结构不变，确保了约化结果的有效性。实验部分基于子集和（subset-sum）问题以及 NTRU 密码系统衍生的格进行测试，结果表明 MergeLLM 相比传统 LLL 和 BKZ 算法，能生成正交性更好、Hermite 因子更优的约化基，同时显著减少昂贵的交换操作次数。该工作对于格密码的高效实现和安全性评估具有潜在价值，尤其适合需要处理高维格基的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 格基约化是格密码安全评估的核心算法，MergeLLL通过分治并行策略大幅提升高维格的约化效率，有助于更准确地评估格密码参数的安全性，也为格密码实现提供了更高效的软件方案。

items.title: DroidBreaker: Practical and Functional Problem-Space Attacks on Machine-Learning Android Malware Detectors
items.summary: Adversarial APKs are Android applications modified in the problem space to evade machine-learning malware detectors. In this work, we first show that, despite claims, existing problem-space attacks remain largely impractical. Most techniques leverage software transplantation to inject entire benign modules, introducing many side-effect features and often causing build-time failures. Fine-grained methods that inject only a narrow subset of components exhibit limited effectiveness, while those that also use obfuscation rely on brittle bytecode rewriting, producing APKs that are syntactically valid but semantically unusable. Prior work further overestimates attack success rates by running smoke tests that only validate installation and basic execution, without assessing whether the modified APK still preserves its intended behavior. To overcome these limitations, we present DROIDBREAKER, a practical (build-safe) and functional (semantics-preserving) problem-space attack framework that provides: (i) query-efficient white- and black-box attacks by manipulating only the APK components most influential to the target model; (ii) a set of fine-grained, build-safe manipulations (including injection and obfuscation of API calls, app modules, permissions, and URLs) with minimal side effects; and (iii) a semantics-preserving functionality test that enforces runtime equivalence by comparing execution logs and API-level traces between the initial and the modified APK. Evaluated on a recent corpus of Android applications, DROIDBREAKER achieves high evasion rates with few queries and minimal side effects in both white-box and black-box settings, and drastically reduces detections by commercial malware scanners hosted on VirusTotal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文聚焦于机器学习驱动的安卓恶意软件检测器面临的问题空间对抗攻击。现有方法大多基于软件移植注入整个良性模块，引入大量副作用特征并常导致构建失败；细粒度方法仅注入少量组件，效果有限；结合混淆的手段依赖脆弱的字节码重写，产出的APK虽语法正确但语义不可用。此外，先前研究往往仅通过安装和基本执行测试来评估攻击成功率，未验证修改后的APK是否保留了原有功能。为克服这些局限性，作者提出DROIDBREAKER——一个实用（构建安全）且功能保持（语义保持）的问题空间攻击框架。其核心创新包括：（1）仅操纵对目标模型影响最大的APK组件，实现查询高效的白盒与黑盒攻击；（2）一组细粒度、构建安全的操作（包括注入和混淆API调用、应用模块、权限和URL），副作用极小；（3）一项语义保持的功能性测试，通过比较初始APK与修改后APK的执行日志和API级迹线来强制运行时等价。在近期安卓应用语料上的实验表明，DROIDBREAKER在白盒和黑盒设置下均能以较少查询和极小副作用实现高逃逸率，并能显著降低VirusTotal上商业恶意软件扫描器的检测率。该研究系统揭示了现有问题空间攻击的不可靠性，并提供了首个兼顾实用性与功能完整性的对抗攻击框架，对评估和提升安卓恶意软件检测器的鲁棒性具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有安卓恶意软件检测器对抗攻击方法的严重缺陷，并提出了首个真正实用且能保持APK功能的攻击框架，对安全社区重新评估检测器鲁棒性、开发更可靠防御具有关键启示。

items.title: TESLA-for-5G: Broadcast Authentication for 5G Networks Using TESLA
items.summary: 5G base stations broadcast unauthenticated system information (SI) that every user equipment (UE) reads during cell selection. This enables attackers to broadcast forged SI from a fake base station (FBS), deceiving UEs into camping on it. Prior approaches require UEs to authenticate System Information Block 1 (SIB1) using digital signatures. This necessitates computation-heavy verification for every SIB1 reception, imposing a significant burden on resource-constrained UEs. We propose TESLA-for-5G (TF5), a broadcast authentication protocol for 5G SIB1 that combines TESLA with GG09 Schnorr-like identity-based signatures (IBS). In the steady state, TF5 enables UEs to authenticate each SIB1 message using a symmetric MAC and delayed key disclosure, eliminating the need for per-message digital signatures. Initial trust is bootstrapped during cell entry using a lightweight GG09 IBS over the TESLA parameters, avoiding certificate distribution overhead. We formally verify TF5 in Tamarin under a Dolev-Yao adversary and demonstrate its favorable computation, communication, and storage costs through both an implementation on the OpenAirInterface 5G stack and trace-driven analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 TESLA-for-5G (TF5) 的广播认证协议，旨在解决 5G 网络中系统信息 (SI) 广播缺乏认证的问题。在 5G 网络中，基站广播未认证的系统信息，用户设备 (UE) 在小区选择时读取这些信息。攻击者可以利用伪造基站 (FBS) 广播伪造的 SI，诱使 UE 驻留其上。现有方法要求 UE 使用数字签名认证每个系统信息块 1 (SIB1)，计算开销大，对资源受限的 UE 造成沉重负担。TF5 结合了 TESLA (时间高效流丢失容忍认证) 和 GG09 Schnorr 类身份基签名 (IBS)。在稳定状态下，TF5 允许 UE 使用对称消息认证码 (MAC) 和延迟密钥披露来认证每个 SIB1 消息，从而避免每个消息的数字签名。初始信任在小区进入时通过轻量级 GG09 IBS 对 TESLA 参数进行引导，避免了证书分发开销。作者在 Tamarin 证明助手下基于 Dolev-Yao 攻击者模型对 TF5 进行了形式化验证，并通过在 OpenAirInterface 5G 协议栈上的实现以及基于跟踪的分析，证明了其计算、通信和存储开销的优越性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 5G 广播认证是确保用户设备不被伪造基站欺骗的关键，TF5 通过降低计算开销实现了实用化，对 5G 安全增强有重要研究意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升 5G 网络广播信道的抗伪造能力，可移植到其他需要广播认证的场景（如 V2X、物联网）。

items.title: ProvenAI: Provenance-Native Traces of Evidence in Generated Answers
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented systems routinely present citations alongside generated answers, yet a citation does not confirm that the corresponding source meaningfully shaped the output. This paper introduces ProvenAI, a framework that decomposes transparency in multi-hop question answering into three independently measurable layers: answer correctness, citation fidelity against benchmark supporting evidence, and per-document influence under leave-one-resource-out intervention. Targeting the HotpotQA distractor benchmark through a seven-stage pipeline covering data normalisation, retrieval indexing, citation-aware answer generation, attribution auditing, ablation-based influence estimation, batch evaluation, and interactive inspection, ProvenAI evaluates 7,405 validation examples drawn from a canonical corpus of 509,300 passages. The system achieves 53.53% answer accuracy alongside a mean citation-fidelity score of 71.55%, and a worked example surfaces what we call the citation-influence gap: a clean citation audit co-occurring with a profile in which one cited source registers only weak influence while seven uncited sources demonstrably shift the output. We formalise the relationship between the implemented surface proxy and a token-level KL-divergence target through a stated faithfulness condition, ground the framework in causal-mediation analysis and database-provenance theory, and discuss how the three measurement layers compose with cryptographic provenance architectures emerging in autonomous scientific discovery. ProvenAI establishes that meaningful transparency in retrieval-grounded QA requires traceable links across retrieved, cited, and behaviourally influential evidence as three distinct, independently measured layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 ProvenAI 框架，旨在解决检索增强生成系统中引文无法证明来源真正影响输出的问题。该框架将多跳问答中的透明度分解为三个独立可测量的层面：答案正确性、引文忠实度（即引文与基准支持证据的匹配程度）以及每文档影响（通过留一资源干预法衡量）。作者在 HotpotQA 干扰项基准数据集上，构建了一个涵盖数据标准化、检索索引、引文感知答案生成、归因审计、基于消融的影响估计、批量评估和交互检查的七阶段流水线，评估了来自 509,300 个段落标准语料库的 7,405 个验证样本。系统实现了 53.53% 的答案准确率和 71.55% 的平均引文忠实度分数。一个工作示例揭示了所谓的“引文-影响差距”：一个引文审计看似干净，但其中一个被引来源仅表现出微弱影响，而七个未引来源却明显改变了输出。本文通过一个明确的忠实性条件，形式化了所实现的表面代理与 token 级 KL 散度目标之间的关系，并将框架建立在因果中介分析和数据库溯源理论基础上。此外，还讨论了三个测量层如何与自主科学发现中出现的加密溯源架构相结合。ProvenAI 表明，检索式问答中的有意义透明度需要将检索到的、引用的和行为上有影响的证据作为三个独立测量的不同层面进行可追溯链接。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前 LLM 回答中的引文可能不可靠，ProvenAI 首次系统度量了引文与真实影响之间的差距，为评估 AI 系统输出透明度提供了可量化方法，对安全审计和合规有重要参考价值。

items.title: What Browsers Do in the Shaders: A Measurement Study of WebGPU Privacy
items.summary: WebGPU lets ordinary web pages run GPU workloads through a validated programming model. Validation protects memory safety, but shared browser, driver, OS, and GPU state can still expose privacy-relevant signals. We present WGPULens, a framework for measuring those signals across controlled scenarios, browser-native co-residency, a participant field study, public page loads, and mitigation policies. Our framework separates measurements: controlled scenarios support leakage, boundary, and mitigation claims; participant runs support deployment, compatibility, and fingerprintability; and a Tranco crawl measures WebGPU exposure in real-world pages. Our controlled results identify persistent pipeline compilation state as the clearest surface. Cold/warm pipeline probes reveal prior compilation state across selected origin, profile, and browser placements. Controlled browser/native experiments also show native GPU activity can be inferred from browser-visible observables under labeled workloads. Other resource probes provide weaker positive results and negative controls. The participant field study shows active WebGPU behavior is highly distinctive within the sample, with deterministic components stable within runs and lower exact stability across repeated visits. A page-load crawl finds WebGPU use mainly as adapter probing and static support code, with no observed page-load shader, pipeline, queue, query, or map activity. Mitigation pilots identify source-level key separation as a proxy for evaluating pipeline-cache partitioning. Overall, WGPULens shows that WebGPU privacy analysis must be surface-specific: browsers need to measure which GPU state crosses which boundary, which browser-visible signals reveal it, and what the corresponding mitigations cost.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WebGPU 是一种允许普通网页通过经过验证的编程模型运行 GPU 工作负载的 Web API，其验证机制保证了内存安全，但共享的浏览器、驱动、操作系统和 GPU 状态仍可能暴露与隐私相关的信号。本文提出了 WGPULens 框架，用于在控制场景、浏览器原生共驻留、参与者实地研究、公共页面加载以及缓解策略等多个维度测量这些信号。框架将测量分为三类：控制实验支持泄露、边界和缓解声明；参与者运行支持部署、兼容性和指纹识别；Tranco 爬虫测量真实世界网页中的 WebGPU 暴露情况。控制实验结果发现，持久性管道编译状态是最清晰的暴露面：冷/热管道探测可以揭示先前跨选中源、配置文件和浏览器位置的编译状态。浏览器/原生共驻留实验还表明，在标记的工作负载下，可以从浏览器可见的观察量推断原生 GPU 活动。其他资源探测提供了较弱的阳性结果和阴性对照。参与者实地研究显示，样本中的活跃 WebGPU 行为具有高度区分性，其确定性组件在运行内稳定，而跨重复访问的精确稳定性较低。页面加载爬虫发现 WebGPU 主要用于适配器探测和静态支持代码，未观察到页面加载着色器、管道、队列、查询或映射活动。缓解试点表明，源级别密钥分离可以作为评估管道缓存分区的代理。总体而言，WGPULens 表明 WebGPU 隐私分析必须针对特定表面：浏览器需要测量哪些 GPU 状态跨越了哪些边界、哪些浏览器可见信号揭示了这些状态，以及相应缓解措施的成本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: WebGPU 是下一代 Web 图形和计算 API，其隐私影响尚未被充分研究。本文首次系统测量了 WebGPU 的隐私泄露面，为浏览器厂商和 Web 应用开发者提供了关键的基线数据与缓解方向。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用 WebGPU 的浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 等）以及依赖 GPU 加速的 Web 应用；可能被用于用户指纹识别或跨上下文追踪。
detection_signals_zh: 冷/暖管道编译时间差异
浏览器可见的 GPU 状态变化（如适配器属性）
defense_advice_zh: 实现源级别的管道缓存分区（如密钥分离）
限制 WebGPU 接口返回的时间精度
对 GPU 编译状态引入随机延迟或噪声
